title: Seerr
name: seerr
description: Request manager for Jellyfin, Plex and Emby, where people ask for films and shows and Sonarr and Radarr fetch them. It's the merged successor to Overseerr and Jellyseerr. Source: https://github.com/seerr-team/seerr
note: Open http://<your-host>:5055 and the setup wizard walks you through connecting your media server, then Sonarr and Radarr. Settings and the request database live in the /app/config volume. Coming from Overseerr or Jellyseerr? Seerr can take over their config, see the docs for how.
